text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-t u-p f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s a-n-d l-e-f-t p-s-e-u-d-o n-a-m-e l-i-s-t-s b-e-h-i-n-d, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l-s
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d p-o-s-i-t-i-v-e r-e-v-i-e-w-s a-n-d l-e-f-t f-o-r-g-e-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k-s
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-a-r-g-e-t-e-d c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r m-a-n-u-s-c-r-i-p-t-s w-i-t-h b-i-a-s-e-d r-e-j-e-c-t-i-o-n s a-n-d l-e-f-t m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e t-r-a-i-l-s, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e d-i-s-l-o-s-s-e-d c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t-s a-s i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t a-n-d l-e-f-t c-o-v-e-r-e-d c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s p-a-c-e-s, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g e-d-i-t-o-r i-a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l r-e-v-i-e-w-s
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d s-y-s-t-e-m g-a-p-s t-o s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-y a-n-d l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d c-o-r-r-u-p-t-e-d m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a, s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d a-n-o-m-a-l-y d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n
